newsitem.title: USA: Catalina settles Black & Decker lawsuits.
newsitem.headline: Catalina settles Black & Decker lawsuits.

text.p: Catalina Lighting Inc said Wednesday it settled the lawsuits brought against the company by Black & Decker Corp.

Catalina said that under the terms of the settlement, it has agreed to a payment to Black & Decker that will result in a one-time net after-tax charge of $600,000 in the current quarter ending March 31.

Catalina Chairman and CEO Robert Hersh said, "The conclusion of this case is in the best interests of our company and eliminates the legal fees which management believed could have exceeded the amount of the settlement."

Catalina Lighting is an international manufacturer and distributor of products for the residential and office lighting industry employing about 3,000 people throughout the U.S., Canada and Southeast Asia.
